The '''Greth Lan-Dwu Corp. electrical power-generating plant''' was a [[Greth Lan-Dwu Corp./Legends|Greth Lan-Dwu Corp.]] facility in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] which generated electricity for Coruscant. [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] fired upon the [[Power coupling/Legends|power couplings]] in an attempt to electrocute [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] during their [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|pursuit]].
